title: Tender
description: The solicitation: what is being bought, how bids are invited, and on what timetable. Mirrors the OCDS tender block.

title.description: A short label for what's being procured.

description.description: A plain-language summary of what's being bought and how bids are invited.

procurementMethod.description: How bids were invited. Optional at Core conformance because real publishers omit it on some notices, but REQUIRED at Standard conformance: without it, the question of how much public spending was never competed is unanswerable.

procurementMethodDetails.description: The publisher's own name for the procedure.

procurementMethodRationale.description: Why this method was chosen. Expected whenever procurementMethod is 'direct' - a sole-source award without a stated reason is the single most common audit finding in public procurement.

classification.description: What is being bought, as scheme-qualified codes: CPV in the EU, UNSPSC globally, NIGP in much of the US. Same propertyID/value pattern as every other identifier in this profile.

procuringEntity.description: The `GovernmentOrganization` running the tender, where different from the process's own `buyer`.

tenderPeriodStart.description: When bids may first be submitted.

enquiryPeriodEnd.description: The deadline for bidders to ask questions, where the process has one.

submissionMethodDetails.description: How and where to submit a bid, in the publisher's own words.

document.description: Links to supporting documents, e.g. the tender notice or bid specification.
